messages:
sara: Heads up — we started seeing client errors from APAC hitting the edge this morning. A handful of requests to service-b are failing TLS with certificate name mismatch.

mike: Do you have the error log snippet?

sara: Yep — from the edge proxy logs: `tls: handshake error: remote error: tls: bad certificate (x509: certificate is valid for service-a.internal.redwood, not service-b.internal.redwood)`

ashley: That sounds like SNI routing returned the wrong cert. Any recent changes to SNI maps or envoy route config?

kevin: Not on our side. We pushed a cert rotation earlier this week (CertRotator job) for service-b. @certbot did the ACME flow and delegated to edge-proxy, but the rotator logs looked OK.

certbot: I checked the rotator run. It successfully wrote new cert to KMS-backed keystore version v3 and emitted event `cert.rotated.service-b`. No obvious errors. Sample rotator output: 
```
INFO Rotator: wrote /keystore/service-b/v3
INFO Notifying edge-proxy via pubsub: cert.rotated.service-b
```

mike: Could be a race where the edge still had the old SNI mapping tied to keystore v2 while the DNS load-balancer directed traffic to a pool with the new certificate. Anyone seen KMS decrypt errors around that timestamp?

ashley: I queried KMS logs for decrypt failures: `resource: projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/keystore/cryptoKeys/service-b` — no decrypt failures. But the edge-proxy access logs show two distinct backend pools: `edge-pool-us` and `edge-pool-apac-canary`. The apac canary returned the wrong cert.

kevin: apac-canary had a different bootstrap — might be a stale keystore mount. Oncall-rotator, can you confirm if the rollout included the canary hosts?

oncall-rotator: Checking: rollout plan was `--stages=canary:5%` and the job annotated nodes via `keystore.mount-version=v3`. I see 3 nodes still reporting `keystore.mount-version=v2` at 10:12 UTC.

sara: That explains the mismatch. Requests hitting those nodes will serve v2 cert (service-a) causing SNI mismatch. Two action items: (1) remount keystore on the remaining nodes; (2) add a quick guard in edge-proxy to reject mismatched CNs instead of serving a different cert.

mike: For remount: `kubectl -n infra rollout restart daemonset/keystore-mount --selector=region=apac-canary` — should force rebind. I'll run it now.

ashley: I'll open a short incident doc: <https://internal.redwood/ops/incidents/3165432100> with details and link to the rotator run. Put steps to validate: `openssl s_client -connect edge-host:443 -servername service-b.internal.redwood` and verify `subject CN` and `X509v3 Subject Alternative Name` entries match service-b.

kevin: Also let's patch the rotator to confirm mount propagation before marking a rotation complete. Low-risk change: after writing keystore vN, poll mount status on all edge hosts for N within 2 minutes. If not, fail the run.

certbot: Noted. I'll file a PR with a short polling loop + exponential backoff. Also adding an audit log entry on rotation completion that includes `keystore_version` and `mounted_hosts` so we have better telemetry.

oncall-rotator: Remount triggered. Nodes show `keystore.mount-version=v3` now. Confirming via `curl -v --resolve edge-host:443:203.0.113.11 https://edge-host/ -H 'Host: service-b.internal.redwood'` — response presents correct certificate CN `service-b.internal.redwood`.

sara: Looks good. Can we add an alert to the TLS telemetry pipeline for CN mismatch rate > 0.1% for 5m? This would catch future partial rollouts.

mike: Yep — I'll open a monitoring ticket. Query suggestion: `sum(rate(tls_handshake_errors{reason="x509_name_mismatch"}[5m])) / sum(rate(tls_handshakes_total[5m])) > 0.001`

ashley: Recap for the incident summary: root cause = partial keystore mount during cert rotation causing SNI mismatch on canary nodes. Mitigation = remounted keystore on canary nodes, added rollout gating and post-rotation mount verification, PR to rotator + auditlog, alert for CN mismatch rate.

kevin: Anything for RBAC/KMS followup? We should ensure the rotator service account has `cloudkms.cryptoKeyVersions.get` on vN and roles to list mount targets. I'll run an IAM diff and post results.

certbot: Also adding an audit log field `authorizing_sa` to the rotation event for easier triage next time.

sara: Great. Thanks everyone. Marking resolved once the PR merges and the monitor is in place. :white_check_mark:
